subject: Important Update: New Payment Method
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to inform you that we have recently introduced a new payment method to make your shopping experience more convenient and secure. Starting from next month, you will have the option to pay using our new online payment gateway, which offers enhanced security features and faster transaction processing. We believe this change will benefit both you and us in the long run. If you have any questions or need assistance with the new payment method, please feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your continued support.
